name: G-Mode Archives+: Spica Adventure
storyline: Nico, a girl adventuring in space, is suddenly covered in a large number of flyers and crashes into the tin planet “Spica”. With the legendary umbrella in hand, Nico embarks on a great adventure, approaching the mystery of the sinking planet while defeating the fancy residents of Spica!
summary: Glide with your umbrella or use it as a boat to cross the sea, allowing you to perform a variety of actions. Run through all 32 stages while searching for hidden items and bonuses in the stage!
